source_screen: Home contact cards; user-authorized visual addition on 2026-10-26
trigger: Primary pointer down, hold, up; existing card click remains its only navigation trigger
preconditions: Visible, enabled Home contact from the canonical home_feed getter
visible_feedback: 120ms light pressure to 0.985, smaller theme shadow, localized cyan/blue/purple/pink glow; 180ms release in parallel with immediate navigation
success_result: Existing current-user card destination opens once; visual feedback creates no relationship or message
failure_result: Movement, pointercancel, lostpointercapture, multiple fingers, background, route hide or disabled state cancel feedback without a ghost click; navigation errors retain the real source
persistence: none; only shared transient touch presentation
sync_scope: Home contact card; reused global touch policy; no Store writes
acceptance: Touch, hold, cancel, vertically drag then release, repeat tap, inspect localized glow and 0.985 scale; Reduce Motion removes spatial scale

failure_result: Invalid bounds safely omit optional feedback; route failure, account change, background and resize clear the visual cue
sync_scope: Home source, global viewport visual host, actual Auto Match entry; no refresh animation reuse

trigger: Existing goal-tag open/close, outside click or scroll dismissal

visible_feedback: Existing anchored panel at 180ms total; 0.94 micro-scale from the actual tag-centered transform origin after edge correction; close returns to that anchor without staggered rows
success_result: Complete goals from Store are readable in the unchanged Popover layout; no card navigation
failure_result: Unavailable measurement, background, resize, hide and unmount cancel pending frames/timers and release the mask; repeated open cannot be closed by a stale callback

source_screen: Home connected-card status and edge following a real consent action
trigger: Successful persisted request acceptance or verified matching acceptance creates a previously absent canonical Connection
preconditions: Same account context, valid source_request_id/source_match_id, actual conversation; no repeated action receipt; Home content is ready
visible_feedback: Status gently fades and a narrow theme edge glint passes once for that connection generation; Reduce Motion uses a short fade only
success_result: Real connected status and chat permission remain entirely Store-derived
failure_result: Failed write, denied/unverified event, decline, cancel, old seed/hydrate relation and ordinary read/refresh never enqueue a cue; hidden/cancelled visuals cannot alter business results
persistence: none; account/connection-specific presentation receipt consumed in process memory
sync_scope: App action-result observer and current Home cards; no separate relationship state
acceptance: Accept a real pending request in an isolated fixture, return Home and observe once; refresh, return and replay do not flash; failure and verified-event tests enforce truthful feedback
